A5366/26 NOTAMN
Q) LTAA/QANLC/I /NBO/E /000/500/4154N03542E091
A) LTAA B) 2611271000 C) 2611271600
E) SEE NOTAM: A5363/26
RNAV ROUTES AND SEGMENTS AFFECTED DURING TEST FIRING AS FLW:
1. AWY L/UL851 KUGOS-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
2. AWY M/UM10 OLUPO-GOKPA SEGMENT CLSD.
INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL AIRCRAFT COULD FOLLOW OLUPO-DCT-CRM.
3. AWY M/UM859 RUVOM-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
AIRCRAFT THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA ROLIN COULD FOLLOW 
UDROS-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN.
AIRCRAFT THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA REBLO AND NOLGA COULD FOLLOW   
UDROS-DCT-CRM-M/UM11-TBN.
4. AWY UM860 KUGOS-CRM SEGMENT CLSD. 
5. AWY N/UN644 INB-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
TRAFFICS THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA ROLIN COULD FOLLOW  
MIMTO-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN.
TRAFFICS USING THIS ROUTE VIA WESTBOUND COULD FOLLOW FALAZ-DCT-CRM.
6. AWY N/UN743 RUVOM-ODIRA SEGMENT CLSD.
INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL AIRCRAFT COULD FOLLOW 
AWY G/UG901 BALUM-CRM BIDIRECTIONALLY.
7. AWY UT61 SIN-UVULU SEGMENT CLSD.
8. AWY T/UT310 OTKOT-SIN SEGMENT CLSD.

VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC-50000FT AMSL
